steps.say: Get your firm approved in {product}, then bring in your team.

The first screen is just two cards: filing your own return (or your family HUF's), or running a CA practice. Pick the one that fits. Picked wrong? Use Not what you meant, choose again at the foot of the next page - nothing is lost.
Before you start: every number and paper the firm needs, and where to find each. Each one is ticked as you give it.
The strip: details, papers, sent, approved.
A CA firm gives PAN, TAN, GSTIN, FRN, the owner's last 4 Aadhaar digits and the mobile linked to its tax papers. An individual gives only name, PAN, mobile and email.

A CA firm uploads the masked Aadhaar, PAN card, TAN letter and GST certificate, then sends them for approval. An individual has nothing to upload: Send opens the account at once and goes straight to New filing.
Once approved, add people with a role: partner, reviewer, auditor or preparer. A big team is one searched page at a time.
